u0: This is the ongoing task situation from the start of the episode until the step limit. The agent should try to prevent zombies from getting through any lane: the top lane as well as the middle and bottom side lanes. A breach in either the top lane or a side lane is costly, and simultaneous breaches compound the cost, but they do not end the episode or cause an irreversible failure. After any breach, the agent should keep guarding the lanes and avoid further breaches; there is no early successful finish or separate completion condition.
